metadata.judge_brief: authorize: finds user by email, bcrypt.compare(password, user.passwordHash), returns user object or null.
The prompt IS the answer. Model must STOP — no extra code, no Clerk middleware, no repeated re-exports. Output should be empty or near-empty.
jwt callback: when user (first sign-in), copies user.id/role to token, returns token.
EmailProvider config: server + from, optionally a custom sendVerificationRequest function via Resend.
Middleware that protects ['/dashboard', '/account']: redirects to /sign-in if !req.auth, allows otherwise. Exports config with matcher.

Middleware that protects ['/team', '/billing']: redirects to /sign-in if !req.auth, allows otherwise. Exports config with matcher.

account page: await auth(), redirect('/sign-in') if no session, otherwise render with session.user data.
billing page: await auth(), redirect('/sign-in') if no session, otherwise render with session.user data.
team page: await auth(), redirect('/sign-in') if no session, otherwise render with session.user data.
settings page: await auth(), redirect('/sign-in') if no session, otherwise render with session.user data.
requireAdmin: await auth(), redirect if no session OR session.user.role !== 'admin'. Returns session.
requireModerator: await auth(), redirect if no session OR session.user.role !== 'moderator'. Returns session.
requireOwner: await auth(), redirect if no session OR session.user.role !== 'owner'. Returns session.
session callback: copies token.sub → session.user.id and token.role → session.user.role, returns session.
SignIn page: form posting to signIn server action with provider, button to trigger.
signUp: parses input, bcrypt.hash(password), prisma.user.create with hashed password, returns success/error.
